rationale: AXON presents conflicting signals: it is in a multi-day selloff due to a downward guidance revision and remains below session VWAP ($306.63), yet short-term price action has reclaimed the 5m 9-EMA ($299.87) with five consecutive bullish 1-minute candles alongside a strongly up market (SPY +2.49%). Entering short fights immediate upward momentum, while entering long goes against the dominant intraday trend and negative catalyst just below VWAP resistance, offering poor risk-reward in either direction.
